title: Thermomix Mexican Rice
description: Tomato and cumin rice with corn and peas, cooked in the bowl. The side the Mexican Beef Bowls and the shredded chicken tacos were missing.

confidence.note: Built from technique. Not yet cooked; the liquid and cook time are a starting point and may need a couple of minutes either way.

items.note: Less if the stock is salty

steps.title: Chop
steps.text: Add the onion ({{onion}}), garlic ({{garlic}} cloves) and capsicum ({{capsicum}}) to the bowl. Chop 3 sec / Speed 5. Scrape down.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.text: Add the olive oil ({{oil}}). Sauté 3 min / 120°C / Speed 1.

steps.title: Toast the rice
steps.text: Add the rinsed rice ({{rice}}), tomato paste ({{tomato-paste}}), cumin ({{cumin}}), smoked paprika ({{smoked-paprika}}) and oregano ({{oregano}}). Toast 2 min / 100°C / Reverse / Speed 1, MC off.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Add the stock ({{stock}}) and salt ({{salt}}). Cook 15 min / 100°C / Reverse / Soft stir, MC off with the simmering basket on the lid.

steps.title: Add the veg
steps.text: Add the corn ({{corn}}) and peas ({{peas}}), if using. Cook 3 min / 100°C / Reverse / Soft stir, until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Leave in the bowl with the lid on for 5 minutes, then tip out and fluff with a fork. Stir through the coriander ({{coriander}}) and serve with lime wedges ({{lime}}).

notes.title: Rinse the rice
notes.text: Rinse until the water runs mostly clear. Unrinsed rice releases starch and sticks to the bowl base.

notes.title: If it is still wet
notes.text: Cook a further 2–3 minutes at 100°C / Reverse / Soft stir with the MC off. If it catches on the base, add a splash of water next time.

notes.title: Uses
notes.text: Under the Mexican Beef Bowls, alongside the shredded chicken tacos, or folded into burritos.
